messages.content: Write a customer testimonial section for the website of a log aggregation service. Around 200 words.

## What our customers say

"We were grepping across four hosts to answer one question. Now it's one query box, and the answer comes back before I've finished typing the ticket number. Onboarding a new SRE takes an afternoon instead of a week."
— Priya Raman, Staff SRE, Marlowe Health

"Our bill went down when we switched, which I did not expect. The retention tiers let us keep 30 days hot and two years cold without maintaining our own S3 lifecycle rules. I stopped thinking about storage, which is the most I can ask of storage."
— Tomas Ekwueme, Infrastructure Engineer, Nightjar Payments

"The alert that caught our last outage fired on a log line nobody had thought to instrument. We wrote the rule in ten minutes off a search we had already run by hand."
— Marta Kovac, Head of Platform, Bellweather Logistics

"Support answered at 2 a.m. in nine minutes. I kept the transcript. I show it to other vendors."
— Chris Nnamdi, DevOps Lead, Vellum Books
